as_told.title: Tesla and Townsend Brown worked together on anti-gravity

plain: The inventor Nikola Tesla worked together with a man named Thomas Townsend Brown sometime between the 1920s and 1940s, on what is framed as anti-gravity research, and word of it came from intelligence, "not from any US source." Harold Malmgren, a former adviser to presidents, says this on two episodes with Michels, once simply calling his source "intelligence" and once stressing it was foreign; in one telling the line is credited to the researcher Steven Greer instead. If true, it would mean a foreign service knew of secret early work on defying gravity that the US kept quiet.
